weakness: Shared operator account passwords on legacy station HMIs (31 stations) were not changed after 4 of 25 sampled departures and transfers; the change depends on a manual email from the station supervisor
remediation_plan: Automated ticket from the HR leaver and mover event to change every shared station password the person knew; quarterly reconciliation of the shared account register against HR data
milestones: 2026-10-15 HR trigger built; 2026-11-15 first quarterly reconciliation; 2026-11-30 all 31 stations live
resources_required: OT service desk workflow (1 sprint); station supervisors

weakness: 9% of applicable Known Exploited Vulnerabilities items on Critical Cyber Systems are past the plan timeline; 5 of 60 sampled patch items late, 4 of them station firmware
remediation_plan: Clear the overdue items in the next maintenance windows or document mitigations with dates; weekly KEV aging report to the CISO
milestones: 2026-10-31 aging report live; 2026-12-31 overdue GCC items cleared; 2027-01-31 station items cleared or mitigated
resources_required: OT engineering (2 FTE for 3 months); outage windows coordinated with Gas Control

weakness: 22 compressor stations (14 on PS-1 and PS-2, 8 on PS-3) run end-of-support HMIs or PLC firmware; documented mitigations exist for 15; plan milestone for the other 7 missed (2026-06-30); no allowlisting or automated logic comparison on these HMIs
remediation_plan: Document and implement mitigations at the remaining 7 stations and inform TSA of the revised date; replace HMIs and PLC firmware in the 2027 to 2028 station program, starting with the 8 highest-consequence stations
milestones: 2026-12-31 mitigations at all 22 stations; 2027-06-30 first 8 stations replaced; remaining 14 in 2028 under the replacement program
resources_required: $6.9M first phase (funded); compression engineering project team

weakness: 7 always-on cellular modems used by one compression equipment manufacturer for turbine monitoring at 5 stations bypass the OT remote access gateway (no per-session approval, no MFA, no recording)
remediation_plan: Remove the modems and move turbine monitoring to a gateway-brokered, one-way data feed; contract amendment with the manufacturer
milestones: 2026-10-31 contract amendment signed; 2026-11-30 data feed through the gateway tested; 2026-12-15 all 7 modems removed

weakness: No passive OT network monitoring at 22 compressor stations (all 20 PS-3 stations and 2 JV-3 stations) or at meter and valve sites; no communications baseline there
source: P07 assessment (SI-04a.01, SI-04c.01); P03 G-022, G-029
remediation_plan: Install passive sensors at the 22 stations and onboard them to the OT monitoring cell; pilot sampling at the 40 most critical meter and valve sites
milestones: 2026-12-15 PS-1 to PS-3 design approved; 2027-02-28 sensors at 22 stations; 2027-03-31 baselines and use cases live

weakness: 22 compressor stations keep logs locally for 90 days with limited event types and do not forward them to the SIEM, against the 12-month standard
source: P07 assessment (AU-06a., AU-11, AU-12a.); P03 G-032, G-033
remediation_plan: Forward station HMI, firewall, and switch logs to the SIEM through the station log collectors installed with the POAM-005 sensors; enable additional event types where the HMI supports them
milestones: 2027-02-28 collectors installed; 2027-03-31 forwarding and retention verified

weakness: Mitigations for 14 of 38 OT components that cannot have memorized secrets reset on schedule are past their documented timeframe
remediation_plan: Complete the 14 overdue mitigations; add due-date alerts to the mitigation register
milestones: 2026-11-15 alerts live; 2026-12-31 overdue mitigations complete

weakness: 3 of 60 sampled OT accounts of transferred staff kept access beyond 5 business days; transfers do not trigger an OT access review automatically
remediation_plan: Send HR mover events to the OT access workflow so the approving owner must confirm or remove access within 5 business days
milestones: 2026-11-30 trigger built; 2026-12-31 live with first monthly report

weakness: 2 of 40 sampled SCADA display and point changes had no point-to-point verification record attached at release
remediation_plan: Change workflow blocks release of a display or point change without an attached verification record
milestones: 2026-11-30 workflow change built; 2026-12-31 live

weakness: 3 of 25 sampled TSA submission records in the SSI library were not marked as SSI under 49 CFR 1520.13
remediation_plan: Mandatory sensitivity label on the TSA submission library; marking check of every record each quarter; refresher for the 212 users with access
milestones: 2026-10-31 label enforced; 2026-12-31 first quarterly check and refresher complete

weakness: The PSGCS contingency plan covers loss of a gas control center but not a fault or compromise of the common SCADA platform that affects GCC-1 and GCC-2 at once
remediation_plan: Add a platform-wide failure scenario with manual operation and staged restore; keep offline golden images of the prior SCADA release; run a drill
milestones: 2026-12-31 plan v7 approved; 2027-02-28 golden images verified; 2027-03-31 drill complete

weakness: IT/OT isolation has been exercised only at GCC-1; GCC-2 and PS3-CR isolation and PS-3 manual operation at scale have not been exercised, and PS-3 positions did not take part in the 2026 exercise
remediation_plan: Isolation exercise at GCC-2 and at PS3-CR, each combined with a manual operation drill and the PS-3 positions named in the plan
milestones: 2026-12-10 GCC-2 exercise; 2027-02-24 PS3-CR exercise and PS-3 manual operation drill; 2027-03-31 after-action items closed
resources_required: Gas Control and OT security staff time; field crews for the PS-3 drill

weakness: The SEC materiality step in the incident response plan has no curtailment or shutdown factors (reservation charge credits, shipper claims, tariff obligations), and the disclosure committee has not exercised an OT shutdown scenario
source: P07 assessment (IR-08a.04, IR-08a.05); P03 G-123, G-124
remediation_plan: Add curtailment and shutdown factors to the materiality playbook; tabletop with the disclosure committee and Gas Control on 2026-11-12
milestones: 2026-10-30 playbook update; 2026-11-12 tabletop; 2026-11-30 lessons incorporated

weakness: 2 of 6 critical OT suppliers (including the PS-3 legacy SCADA vendor) have no incident notice terms; the SCADA vendor provides no software bills of materials or signed-update attestation
remediation_plan: Contract amendments with incident notice within 24 hours, software bills of materials, and signed updates; extended soak testing of major SCADA releases until signed updates arrive
milestones: 2026-12-31 amendment with the PS-3 vendor; 2027-03-31 SCADA vendor amendment at renewal; 2027-06-30 SBOMs received and loaded into vulnerability management

weakness: 7 of 60 sampled field devices traced from the field were missing from the OT asset inventory (all 7 on PS-3)
remediation_plan: Field walkdowns at all PS-3 stations and meter sites; passive discovery from the new sensors (POAM-005)
milestones: 2026-12-31 walkdowns at 20 PS-3 stations; 2027-03-31 reconciliation with passive discovery

weakness: PS-3 is not yet at enterprise standards: 12 of 20 stations have flat networks; polling crosses the shared corporate MPLS unencrypted; legacy SCADA uses shared local accounts disabled weekly; PS3-CR lacks badge and PIN floor control and console logging; no alternate control site, no offline backup copy, no tested rebuild; separate incident tools
remediation_plan: Execute the PS-3 integration plan in the TSA-approved amendment: segment the 12 stations, encrypt polling, weekly offline backup copy to GCC-2, then migrate PS-3 to the main SCADA platform and GCC-1 and retire PS3-CR
milestones: 2026-12-31 weekly offline backup copy to GCC-2; 2027-03-31 segmentation and IPsec polling at all 20 stations; 2027-06-30 cutover to SYS-01 and GCC-1
resources_required: $2.2M segmentation and encryption (funded within the PS-3 integration budget); integration team

weakness: PS-3 controllers have not completed the cyber abnormal operating condition simulator module; 6 of 25 sampled OT engineers were past due for ICS security training
remediation_plan: Run the simulator module for the 18 PS-3 controllers at GCC-1; enroll overdue OT engineers; due-date reminders
milestones: 2026-12-31 OT engineers current; 2027-03-31 PS-3 controllers trained

weakness: Manufacturer default passwords found on 6 of 20 PS-3 field devices tested (RTUs and flow computers) during the assessment
source: P07 assessment (IA-05e.), new finding reported to the CISO on 2026-08-07
remediation_plan: Change defaults on all PS-3 field devices; add a default-credential check to the PS-3 migration checklist and to commissioning
milestones: 2026-09-30 6 devices fixed (done); 2026-11-30 all PS-3 devices checked; 2026-12-15 checklist updated

weakness: The leak-detection model vendor deployed two model updates to production in 2026 without staging, backtesting, or Gas Control approval (SYS-12, outside the PSGCS boundary)
remediation_plan: Remove vendor production deployment rights; promotion only through the staging slot after backtest and Gas Control approval; contract amendment requiring 30 days notice of model changes
milestones: 2026-10-15 vendor production rights removed; 2026-11-30 contract amendment signed

weakness: Hosts at 31 compressor stations are not credential-scanned; vulnerability identification there relies on passive monitoring and vendor notices
remediation_plan: Extend credentialed scanning to station Windows hosts in maintenance windows, starting with stations that have new HMIs
milestones: 2026-12-31 scan profiles approved by Gas Control; 2027-01-31 first full cycle

weakness: PS-3 SCADA telecommunications use a single carrier, and 140 meter and valve sites are cellular-only with no second path
remediation_plan: Second carrier for PS-3; second path (satellite or second carrier) at the 40 most critical cellular-only sites
milestones: 2027-03-31 second PS-3 carrier live; 2027-06-30 40 sites with second path

weakness: 2 permanent changes to plan measures in 2026 (new remote access gateway product; new SIEM) were not submitted to TSA within 50 days
source: P03 gap G-065 (SD 02G Sections VI.B and VI.D)
remediation_plan: File both amendment requests; add a plan-measure check to change management (PRC-01.3)
milestones: 2026-10-15 both requests filed; 2026-11-30 change management check live

milestones: 2026-11-30 reviews of AI-008, AI-009, AI-011; 2026-12-31 review of AI-010 with counsel

milestones: 2026-11-30 ticket rule live; 2026-12-31 refresher complete
